name: Return Stroke's Floating Memory pays a champion level-up's memory cost from graveyard
notes: Return Stroke is an ATTACK card, but Floating Memory only cares about paying a memory cost from the graveyard -- unrelated to its own reserve cost or to it ever being played as an attack -- so the champion-level-up-from-graveyard shape already proven by honorable-vanguard-floating-memory / shieldroid-floating-memory / stalwart-shieldmate-floating-memory applies unchanged. Return Stroke is seeded directly into the graveyard, with no myMemory filler, and Lorraine, Wandering Warrior's 1-memory champion level-up is initiated from myMaterial-0; selecting myGraveyard-0 pays the full cost and PAYFLOATING moves the card straight to myBanish. Return Stroke's other clause, "[Class Bonus] Return Stroke gets +LVPOWER" (LV = your champion's level), is a computed combat-time power buff with no independently stored counter, so it's out of scope here.

rulesClauses: Floating Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may banish this card from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost.)
